name: Blink
description: Blinks an LED with Serial status logging.

name: Non-Blocking Blink
description: Blinks an LED without delay(), using millis() timing instead.

name: Button
description: Bouncy button read, settles after the ~10ms bounce window.

name: Clean Button
description: A CLEAN/IDEAL-named button, exempt from bounce simulation.

name: Switch
description: A toggle switch that stays flipped until clicked again.

name: Buzzer Tone
description: tone()/noTone() on a buzzer, visualized as active on the canvas.

name: Servo Sweep
description: Sweeps a servo back and forth between 0 and 180 degrees.

name: H-Bridge Motor (bare pins)
description: L298N/L293D-style motor driver, bare ENA/IN1/IN2 pin names.

name: H-Bridge Motor (named pins)
description: Same motor driver, using a shared MOTOR_ prefix naming style.

name: Stepper Motor
description: STEP/DIR driver style stepper motor control.

name: Potentiometer
description: Reads an analog potentiometer, drag it on the canvas.

name: Rotary Encoder
description: CLK/DT quadrature encoder, direction resolved via an interrupt.

name: Joystick
description: Two-axis analog joystick with a digital press switch.

name: Light Sensor
description: An LDR read as a plain analog input.

name: Temperature Sensor
description: An analog temperature sensor (thermistor/TMP36-style).

name: Force Sensor
description: A force-sensitive resistor (FSR) as an analog input.

name: Generic Analog Sensor
description: A pin named with a generic sensor/analog/ADC keyword.

name: Generic Input
description: A pin name that doesn't match any known keyword still works, just with no special canvas visualization.

name: IR Sensor
description: A simple digital IR obstacle-detection sensor.

name: Distance Sensor
description: Reads an ultrasonic distance sensor and lights an LED when something is within 10cm.

name: Color Sensor
description: TCS3200-style color sensor, using array-declared pins.

name: Keypad
description: 4x4 membrane keypad, click cells on the canvas grid.

name: DHT Sensor
description: DHT11/DHT22 temperature + humidity sensor.

name: MAX7219 LED Matrix
description: 8x8 LED matrix driven via setLed/setRow/setColumn.

name: NeoPixel Strip
description: WS2812B strip chasing a lit pixel via setPixelColor/show.

name: SSD1306 OLED
description: 128x64 I2C display drawing text and a moving circle.

name: Seven-Segment Display
description: One pin per segment (A-G), no decimal point.

name: RGB LED
description: Three PWM pins cycling through red, green, and blue.

name: LCD Serial Echo
description: Echoes Serial input back out to both the Serial Monitor and a 16x2 LCD.

name: Wire (I2C)
description: beginTransmission/write/endTransmission/requestFrom against the virtual I2C device panel.

name: SPI
description: transfer() against the virtual SPI byte-sequence panel.

name: SoftwareSerial
description: begin/print/println on a software serial port, routed to the Serial Monitor.

name: EEPROM
description: read/write/update against the 1024-byte EEPROM.

name: AVR GPIO Registers
description: Direct DDRx/PORTx/PINx register access instead of pinMode/digitalWrite/digitalRead.

name: AVR Timer Registers
description: Direct Timer1/Timer2 register access -- prescaler, PWM duty, and overflow/compare-match ISRs.

name: Interrupts
description: attachInterrupt on a button press, counted in an ISR.

name: Watchdog Timer
description: wdt_enable/wdt_reset/wdt_disable, and a watchdog waking the CPU from sleep.

name: Sleep Modes
description: sleep_enable/sleep_cpu/sleep_disable, woken by the watchdog.

name: Serial Plotter
description: Two named values on one line, graphed as separate traces in the Serial Plotter tab.
